neutral_facts: The accused was convicted of an offence under Section 376(1) of the Indian Penal Code. The accused was to be taken into custody to undergo a sentence of seven years imprisonment and a fine of Rs. 5,000. However, the accused had already died on October 14, 2012, which was not known to the court at the time of the judgment. The court recalled its previous judgment and dismissed the appeal as it had become abated due to the death of the accused.
